first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The dark blue open-wheel single-seat race car carrying the cockpit viewpoint, with its front wheels, cockpit rim, and dark protective frame with a central pillar visible.

entities.name: gray paved racetrack
entities.identification: The gray paved road surface extending continuously ahead of Vehicle A and converging in the distance.

entities.name: light blue sky
entities.identification: The light blue sky within the opening of the protective frame, above the distant ground scenery.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The driver holding the steering wheel inside Vehicle A, with only both hands in dark blue gloves and parts of the forearms visible.

entities.name: multi-button steering wheel
entities.identification: The black irregularly shaped steering wheel held by Person A, with a concave upper edge, multicolored buttons, and circular knobs.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The low, small race car on the road surface ahead of Vehicle A, appearing at a distance as a horizontal vehicle silhouette with dark protrusions on both sides.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: The narrow alternating red-and-white strip along the right road boundary.

entities.name: grass beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The green grass strips outside the road and the grassy slope behind the fence on the right.

entities.name: trees beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The clustered green tree canopies outside the road, with some trunks partially visible.

entities.name: racetrack safety barrier
entities.identification: The continuous low, light-colored wall outside the road, partly bearing green advertising surfaces, with an orange wall section in the earlier portion.

entities.name: racetrack metal mesh fence
entities.identification: The fence outside the road, composed of repeated vertical posts, horizontal connecting lines, and fine mesh.

entities.name: tiered grandstand
entities.identification: The tiered grandstand on the right with a broad, light-colored roof, and the open-air grandstand ahead and slightly to the left.

entities.name: colored paved runoff area
entities.identification: The flat green paved strip outside the red-and-white curb on the right.

entities.name: cross-track gantry
entities.identification: The green crossbeam and diagonal components along its lower edge partially exposed at the upper right at the start of the clip.

entities.name: racetrack sign
entities.identification: The group consisting of green advertising surfaces, light-background distance boards, and a large rectangular screen on the right.

entities.name: distant low-rise buildings
entities.identification: The light-colored, flat-roofed rectangular building behind the wall on the left.

entities.name: spectators beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The dense crowd in the grandstand and the more dispersed groups of small human figures on the grassy slope on the right.

entities.name: cockpit instrument display
entities.identification: The fixed black rectangular display above and behind the steering wheel, showing a large 6, small characters, and colored bars.
